assets.name: Front-loading washer with painted number and opening glass door
assets.notes: 0.75 m wide x 0.75 deep x 1.0 m tall, front toward -Y, origin bottom centre. Children: 'washer.door_hinge' (rotate its rotation_euler.z; NEGATIVE swings the door open toward the viewer, -100 deg = wide open, 0 = shut; use core.move), 'washer.drum' (turns about its local Z = the Y axis: key rotation_euler.z), 'washer.number' (a text curve, big black, set its .data.body = '9' to renumber; 0.15 m tall), 'washer.tag_anchor' (empty on the door handle, where a tag is tied). Door centre is 0.55 m up. Place several 1 m apart; rot_z=-90 turns the front to face +X for the west wall.

assets.name: Laundromat service counter
assets.notes: 2.0 m long (X) x 0.70 m deep (Y) x 1.05 m high, customer side toward -Y, origin bottom centre. Top surface at z = 1.05 (things on it rest there). rot_z=90 turns the customer side to face +X (runs along Y); rot_z=-90 faces -X.

assets.name: Round wall clock with settable hands
assets.notes: 0.50 m across, 0.05 m deep, face toward -Y, origin at the bottom of the case, so the clock centre is 0.25 m up: to hang it with its centre at height H put it at z = H - 0.25. Children 'clock.hour', 'clock.minute', 'clock.second' are pivots at the centre; rotation_euler.y is the angle, POSITIVE = clockwise as the viewer sees it, 0 = pointing at 12. Hour = ((h % 12) + m / 60) * 30 deg, minute = m * 6 deg, second = s * 6 deg. Rest pose 10:10. For a clock on the west wall facing east, give the group rot_z=-90.
